hard_findings.title: Route the new query entrypoints through the generated SQLite snapshot
hard_findings.rule: docs/adr/0002-yaml-in-git-is-the-master-copy-sqlite-is-generated.md:6 states every query runs against that database
hard_findings.evidence: New query functions obtain Store from _require_valid and call get/of_kind directly; _require_valid returns validate_records(...).store without indexing. profile-strategies/strategy-regions accept --db but ignore it. get --chain reads root from SQLite then descendants from YAML Store.
hard_findings.action: Reuse a generated-index-backed record view after freshness validation for query selection and chain traversal, while preserving live raw-artifact verification. Or explicitly revise ADR with an approved exception rather than silently diverging.
